turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Hi doctor—I'm a 44-year-old man. For the past three weeks I’ve noticed small, non-itchy bumps on my left thigh, and over the last few months I’ve had fatigue and general malaise. I haven’t had any known medical problems and I’m not on any regular medications.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any small, raised bumps on your skin that have a tiny indentation or a "dimple" in the center?
turns.patient_answer: “Yes, doctor—I have small, raised bumps on my left thigh that look like they have a slight central indentation.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that you need to urinate more often than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed needing to urinate more often than usual.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling generally weak or lacking your usual strength lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, yes—I’ve been feeling generally weak and not like myself for a few months, with that overall fatigue and malaise.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any difficulty with dressing yourself lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Yes, doctor—I've felt more weak and run-down, but I haven’t had any specific trouble dressing myself or doing everyday tasks. The main issue has been the fatigue and malaise.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rashes, bumps, or sores appearing specifically along the veins in your arms?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any rashes, bumps, or sores along the veins in my arms. The only skin changes are those small, non-itchy bumps on my left thigh.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itchiness on your skin?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—those bumps on my left thigh are not itchy at all. I haven’t had any itching elsewhere on my skin either.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you experience any pain or cramping in your calves when you walk that goes away once you stop and rest?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I don’t get pain or cramping in my calves when I walk, and it doesn’t improve with rest. My main concerns have been the small non-itchy bumps on my left thigh and the fatigue and malaise for a few months.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed if your stools have become unusually pale, light-colored, or clay-like in appearance?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed my stools becoming pale, light-colored, or clay-like.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any weakness in your hands, or have you found it more difficult than usual to grip or hold onto objects?
turns.patient_answer: “Yes, doctor—I haven’t noticed any weakness in my hands or any difficulty gripping or holding objects; it’s mainly been the fatigue and overall malaise.”

turns.doctor_question: During these shaking episodes, are you able to remain conscious and aware of your surroundings, or do you lose consciousness?
turns.patient_answer: “Yes, doctor—when I’ve had any shaking or episodes, I’ve been able to stay conscious and aware of my surroundings rather than losing consciousness.”
